statement: FRED series DGS10 records a 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield of 5.00 percent or higher on at least one trading day between 2026-11-11 and 2026-12-11. Reference: 4.99 percent on the packet date.
resolution: True if any DGS10 value dated 2026-11-11 through 2026-12-11 on FRED is at or above 5.00; false otherwise.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 value dated 2026-11-11 through 2026-12-11 is below 5.00.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range by at least 50 basis points at its scheduled meeting concluding in December 2026.
resolution: True if the Federal Reserve policy statement for the December 2026 meeting raises the target range by 50 basis points or more; false for any smaller change, hold, or cut.
failure_condition: The December 2026 FOMC statement sets a target range fewer than 50 basis points above the range in force on 2026-11-10.
